name: Tirrus
source:
An adult om’veri wearing dark glasses and featuring a distinctive golden-green appearance. His long neck is covered in large, convex scales of a bright golden color with a metallic luster, which transitions closer to the chest and belly into smooth segments of a dark, rich emerald-green shade. The head has an elegant shape with a well-defined chin and large, almond-shaped eyes of a reddish color. The main feature of his appearance is a pair of large, curved horns of a dark golden-green coloration, which resemble a lyre in shape. Dark plates and short, sharp spikes are located between the horns and on the back of the head. In the background on the left, a translucent green detail with a rounded element in the center is visible, resembling a mechanical or magical structure, and part of a wing in gray-blue tones is noticeable at the bottom.
Tirrus appears to be an erudite sarantales, as during training with Azaries, he conducts a quiz that affects the course of the match.
